# list_llm_files_tool

> List files and subdirectories in the LLM file system, similar to browsing a file manager.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=list_llm_files_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

List files and subdirectories in the LLM file system, similar to browsing a file manager.

COMMON USE CASES:
- Browse root directory to see top-level organization: {directory_path: "/"}
- List files in a specific folder: {directory_path: "/projects/docs"}
- Find all images: {file_type: "LlmImage"}
- Search for a file by name: {title_search: "report"}
- See full directory tree: {directory_path: "/", show_tree: true}
- List everything in a project recursively: {directory_path: "/projects", recursive: true}

Use read_llm_file_tool with a file ID to get full content.

CROSS-TENANT: a directory_path that belongs to a directory shared with you from
another tenant resolves automatically and lists that directory's contents.
Individual files shared with you (e.g. attachments in a shared conversation) are
readable via read_llm_file_tool by id even when no directory is shared.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `directory_path` | string | no | Directory path to list contents of (defaults to "/"). Example: "/projects/docs". |
| `recursive` | boolean | no | Include files from all subdirectories recursively (default: false) |
| `file_type` | string | no | Filter by file type: LlmDocument, LlmImage, LlmAudioFile, LlmVideoFile, LlmSpreadsheet, LlmPresentationFile. |
| `title_search` | string | no | Find files by title (case-insensitive partial match). With NO directory_path, searches ALL files in the tenant; pass a directory_path to constrain the search to that folder. |
| `show_tree` | boolean | no | Return hierarchical directory tree structure instead of flat file listing (default: false) |
| `entity_type` | string | no | List files ATTACHED TO a record rather than browsing a folder, e.g. "BizTxnEvent" for a support ticket or "LlmConversation" for a channel. Requires entity_id. Ignores directory_path. Includes attachments a partner posted from another tenant. |
| `entity_id` | integer | no | Id of the record named by entity_type, e.g. the ticket id. |

## Example

Find a file by name anywhere in the workspace:

```json
{"name": "list_llm_files_tool", "arguments": {"title_search": "contract"}}
```

Browse a folder tree:

```json
{"name": "list_llm_files_tool", "arguments": {"directory_path": "/Sales & Marketing", "show_tree": true}}
```

Files attached to a record (a support ticket, a channel):

```json
{"name": "list_llm_files_tool", "arguments": {"entity_type": "BizTxnEvent", "entity_id": 1234}}
```

## Gotchas

- **`title_search` without `directory_path` searches the whole workspace**; add a path to
  narrow it.
- **Large listings are truncated** with `truncated: true` and a notice — narrow by path,
  type or title rather than paging blindly.
